label: prop:bring-trilog-imaginary-tate-rational
title: Trilogarithm imaginary part at $\zeta_5$: Tate-rational closed form $4\pi^3/125$ via Kummer reflection (50-dps verified)
html:
Proposition. Trilogarithm imaginary part at \zeta_5: Tate-rational closed form 4\pi^3/125 via Kummer reflection (50-dps verified)

The imaginary part of the Bring trilog at \zeta_5 evaluates as:

  \mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_3(\zeta_5)
  \;=\;
  S_3\!\left(\tfrac{2\pi}{5}\right)
  \;=\;
  \frac{4 \pi^3}{125}.

Because 4\pi^3/125 lies in (2\pi i)^3 \cdot \mathbb{Q}, it is Tate-rational. It projects to zero under the Beilinson regulator quotient \mathcal{P}_3 \to \mathcal{P}_3 / \mathrm{Tate}.

This proposition halves the depth-3 unproved surface. The imaginary part resolves to a known rational multiple of \pi^3. The Borel-predicted 2-dimensional regulator image is generated entirely by the real parts \mathrm{Cl}_3(2\pi/5) and \mathrm{Cl}_3(4\pi/5). The real part \mathrm{Cl}_3(2\pi/5) stands alone as the genuinely new depth-3 period.
